results.name: Status is neutral and the full owner lifecycle survives processes
Concurrent acquire has exactly one winner and cannot clobber its record
Invalid tokens cannot assert, heartbeat, release, or alter bytes
A stale heartbeat stays held and cannot be acquired again
Malformed and incomplete records fail closed for every command
A record read failure cannot be mistaken for a free lease
Clock rollback cannot poison the owner record or prevent release
Root arrays and noninteger schema versions cannot masquerade as valid records
An unavailable exclusive guard fails busy without granting a lease
Linked worktrees resolve the same absolute lease regardless of target path
Missing arguments and nonrepository paths fail with JSON and nonzero exit

scope: Isolated temporary Git repository and linked worktree; hidden child processes; no Unity operations and no real lease acquisition.
